db_user.description: MySQL user for Sphinx to connect as

db_pass.description: MySQL password (leave empty if no password needed)

db_name.description: Name of the MySQL database to index

start_id.description: Start ID for incremental indexing (usually set dynamically during indexing)

data_path.description: Base path for storing index files

morphology.description: Morphology processor to use (e.g., stem_en, stem_ru, none)

min_prefix_len.description: Minimum prefix length for prefix indexing (0 disables it)

min_infix_len.description: Minimum infix length for infix indexing (0 disables it)

charset_table.description: List of charset mapping rules. Leave empty to use defaults.

searchd_listen_host.description: IP address searchd listens on (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0')

searchd_listen_port.description: TCP port for SphinxQL and native protocol

searchd_read_timeout.description: Read timeout in seconds for client connections

searchd_max_children.description: Maximum number of worker processes searchd can spawn

binlog_path.description: Path for binary log files (empty disables binlog)

binlog_flush.description: Flush binlog on every transaction (1 = safe, 0 = faster but less durable)

searchd_worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for request handling

searchd_plugins.description: List of plugin directories to load

name.description: Descriptive name for the listen endpoint

listen_spec.description: Optional host/IP part (e.g., 'unix:', or omit for default)

searchd_listen_options.description: Additional listen endpoints (e.g., for MySQL protocol on port 9306)
